who: Owns a neighbourhood restaurant and is opening a second, smaller place.

moments.plot: The second place opens in three weeks and has no extractor hood.

tasks.title: Choose the extractor hood
tasks.notes: It has to go out through the back wall. Upstairs sleeps above the front.

tasks.title: Measure for the long table
tasks.notes: Leave enough room for a tray and a person. Mira walks it with a tray first.

tasks.title: Get a third set of keys cut
Ask the school about their old stools
Taste the new flatbread with Kofi

capture.title: Ask Kofi for the dough ratio

file.title: Who fixes the back door?
file.notes: It sticks when it rains. The lease says the owner, the owner says the lease.

dated.title: Friends and family night
dated.notes: Twenty people, no menu. Kofi cooks what is left from {weekday+4}.

repeating.title: Order fish before ten
repeating.notes: No skate until they fix the price.

attachments.notes: Paper changes faster, chalk looks better from the street. Mira took photos of both. The printer needs the text two days before.

agent.title: Line up the three hood quotes
agent.notes: Three PDFs, three ways of hiding the installation cost. I need one number each.
agent.question: Which should count more?
bodies: Only the first firm can install before the opening. Its total is €7,150 with the wall work. The other two start in January.
The third firm is the cheapest at €6,320 with the wall work, but it installs in the second week of January.
agent.otherBody: The totals with wall work are €7,150, €6,840 and €6,320. Looking at it your way: {answer}
agent.acceptance: You can call one firm and say yes.

discuss.title: Answer the neighbour upstairs
discuss.notes: Worried about smell and late noise. Friendly letter, three pages.
discuss.question: What do you want to promise?
bodies: Thank you for writing. The hood goes out through the back wall, away from your windows, and the kitchen closes at eleven every night.
Thank you for writing. Would you like to come down and see the plans? The hood goes out at the back, and I would rather show you than explain it.
discuss.otherBody: Thank you for writing. About the smell and the noise: {answer}
discuss.otherAnswer: Filters in by May, and my number
discuss.handoff: Your next step: put it through the door

review.title: Line up the three hood quotes
review.note: One total each. The second quote leaves out the crane, so I added it.

review.title: Write the allergen sheet
review.note: Fourteen dishes. Please check the flatbread, the recipe says two things.
